fields.name: Disappears Over Time
fields.description: When enabled, the carrot disappears after a delay.

fields.name: Hidden in Grass
fields.description: When enabled, the carrot starts hidden in the grass.

fields.name: Interaction Mode
fields.description: Selects the behavior used after an interaction. When set, the carrot deactivates instead of detaching in the corresponding interaction branch.

fields.name: Movement Direction
fields.description: Determines the direction in which the carrot moves.

0.name: Positive X
0.description: Moves along the positive X axis.

1.name: Negative X
1.description: Moves along the negative X axis.

2.name: Positive Y
2.description: Moves along the positive Y axis.

3.name: Negative Y
3.description: Moves along the negative Y axis.
